headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Vercel's documentation spans 6,845 crawled pages with strong retrieval readiness (88.38 overall score, 97.88% answerability). Critical gaps include 43 confirmed broken internal links across user-facing docs, API reference coverage at only 15.0% despite 1,119 API pages detected, and last-updated metadata visible on just 47.66% of pages. Example code reliability stands at 81.69%, and 53.14% of content carries stale risk due to missing freshness signals. Evidence coverage is solid at 86.46% (11,518 of 13,321 claims backed), but low API coverage and broken links directly undermine user trust and AI answer quality.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

priority_actions.title: Fix all 43 broken internal links in user-facing docs
priority_actions.why_this_first: Immediate trust and SEO win; broken links frustrate users, harm search rankings, and signal neglect—quick fix with broad surface impact.

priority_actions.title: Add last-updated timestamps to the 52.34% of pages currently missing them
priority_actions.why_this_first: Reduces 53.14% stale risk, enables users to assess currency, and improves AI answer confidence by surfacing freshness signals.

priority_actions.title: Expand API usage examples and integration guides to cover the 85% of 1,119 API pages currently at 15% coverage
priority_actions.why_this_first: Directly accelerates developer onboarding, reduces support tickets, and unlocks API adoption—highest business value despite higher effort.

strengths: High answerability (97.88%) and chunkability (92.26%) support strong LLM retrieval and user comprehension
86.46% of key claims include supporting evidence, reducing ambiguity and increasing trust
100% citationability ensures all content can be properly attributed in AI-generated answers
risks: 43 broken internal links in user-facing docs degrade navigation, SEO, and user confidence
API reference coverage at 15.0% leaves 85% of 1,119 API pages without usage examples or integration guidance
53.14% stale risk due to missing last-updated dates prevents users from assessing content currency
Only 47.66% of pages display last-updated metadata, obscuring freshness for half the documentation
limitations: External audit cannot verify content technical accuracy, only structural signals like evidence presence and example syntax.
2 links blocked by auth/rate-limit could not be verified; internal tooling may reveal additional broken references.
API coverage detection relies on heuristics; actual developer needs may differ from detected API surface area.
automation_first: Deploy CI link checker to catch broken internal links before publish; 43 confirmed breaks indicate no pre-merge validation, and automated checks would prevent user-facing navigation failures and SEO damage.

Automate last-updated timestamp injection from Git commit history for the 52.34% of pages missing freshness metadata; this would eliminate 53.14% stale risk and improve AI retrieval confidence with minimal manual overhead.

Implement API reference coverage dashboard tracking the 1,119 API pages against usage examples; current 15.0% coverage suggests no systematic monitoring, and automated reporting would prioritize high-traffic endpoints and measure progress toward developer onboarding goals.
